display_title: 5th Innowwide call for market feasibility projects – Autumn 2026 – Innowwide
organization_or_parent_framework: Eureka Network (European Partnership on Innovative SMEs, Horizon Europe)
call_title: 5th Innowwide call for market feasibility projects – Autumn 2026
executive_summary: A bottom-up call, funded by the EU through the European Partnership on Innovative SMEs and run by the Eureka Secretariat, that gives a fixed grant of EUR 60,000 to an innovative SME to carry out a six-month market feasibility project in a target country in Africa, the Americas, Asia or Oceania, with one local partner as main subcontractor. Only a single SME established for at least two years in an EU Member State, Iceland, Israel, Norway, Switzerland, Türkiye or the United Kingdom may apply; the innovation must be at TRL 4 to 8, and total eligible costs must be at least EUR 86,000. The call has EUR 4.2 million for 70 projects; there is no Dutch national co-financing. Applications close on 1 December 2026 at 14:00 CET.
status_rationale: The call funds six-month market feasibility projects of single innovative SMEs to bring their product or service to markets outside Europe (Eureka call page, 'What is a market feasibility project?' and 'Who can apply'; RVO Innowwide page, 'Voorwaarden'). It does not touch TenneT's field: it is a general SME internationalisation instrument for any sector, aimed at markets in Africa, the Americas, Asia or Oceania, and no project file is close to it.
